shortDescription.default: Adds a floating Feedback tab to any SharePoint modern page.

longDescription.default: Adds a fixed floating Feedback tab to SharePoint modern pages. Clicking the tab opens a side panel with a configurable feedback form. Responses (comment, star rating, page URL, and submitting user) are saved automatically to a SharePoint list named Feedback Responses.

features.title: Feedback Tab Feature
features.description: Activates the Feedback Tab web part.
